_comment: The acceptance gate: every page/state/viewport/auth combination that was accepted with MISSING=0 STRUCTURE=0 DRIFT=0.
Run it with tools/fidelity/accept/gate-all.sh (docs/fidelity-remediation/README.md §9). Nothing here is machine-specific.
Both sides are captured scoped to `scope`; INK is captured fresh every run, the Lovable reference is captured once into
the ref dir and reused until the Lovable build changes (or --refresh-refs). The diff uses `map` with --fail-on.
`lovable` and `ink` are paths under the two bases (tools/fidelity/targets.json `bases`, overridden by INK_URL / LOVABLE_URL
or `lovablePreview` in tools/local.config.json). `{name}` is a lookup resolved at run time (see `lookups`), so a refresh that
shifts ids or adds rounds does not break a path. Reading posts use `?p=<id>`: prod post ids are stable.
gate fields: group, page (capture name), lovable, ink, map, scope/scopeLabel, auth ('none' | 'both'), states (each:
name, click[], viewports[]; a gate with no `states` has the one default state), display (name shown in the report).

lookups._comment: round: a published `uitdaging` whose slug starts with `prefix` (newest first). uitslae is the status that round's /uitslae/ must give: 200 = has results, 404 = none. issue: published inkpols_uitgawe, newest first; `index` -1 is the oldest. award: first slug in verse-haven/src/data/awards.ts (the Lovable results page).

preflight._comment: The Lovable preview must be a build that carries the audit-ids these gates click and scope on (an older build answers 'click selector matched nothing').
